title: Orange Marmalade Pork Tenderloin
description: Tenderloin marinated in sesame ginger dressing, then grilled and slathered near the end with orange marmalade, ginger, garlic, thyme and soy. Slightly sweet, slightly spicy.

steps.heading: Marinate
steps.text: Marinate the tenderloin in the sesame ginger dressing for 4 hours in the fridge.

steps.heading: Make the Glaze
steps.text: Combine the marmalade, ginger, garlic powder, thyme, pepper and soy sauce in a bowl. Set aside.

steps.heading: Grill
steps.text: Heat the grill to 350°F. Take the tenderloin out of the marinade and discard the marinade. Grill over medium-high heat with the lid on for 10 minutes, turning once.

steps.heading: Glaze
steps.text: Take the lid off, brush the marmalade mixture over the tenderloin, and grill 3 to 5 minutes more.

steps.heading: Rest
steps.text: Take the tenderloin off the grill and let it rest 5 minutes before cutting.

notes: Serve with a green salad and Mason Jar Balsamic Dressing.
